attributes.title: JFPS 2027
attributes.summary:
The Joint Federal Pharmacy Seminar returns to National Harbor, Maryland, on October 10 to 12, 2027, according to the meeting's official site. JFPS brings together pharmacists and pharmacy technicians who work in federal health systems, including the uniformed services, the VA and other federal agencies.

The American Pharmacists Association manages the meeting and has served as its continuing pharmacy education provider. The 2027 program, venue details, registration fees and the number of CPE hours have not been published yet.

Federal employees usually need approval to attend, so it is worth checking the organizer's justification materials once registration opens.
